annotations.title: Read recorded Naver search and AI briefing results

description: Reads what uplika has recorded about Naver search and AI briefings, without reading Naver again. With blog: the report card (cards: AI citation rate, search exposure rate, keywords with an AI briefing, cited posts; axes: five scores out of 10 on uplika's own scale with the raw value and threshold of each, not a Naver score; firstThing: the lowest axis; posts with their main keyword and latest verdict; events: when a post started or stopped being cited or shown). With post (a Naver post address, or the id of a post published through Uplika): that post's check history and events. With runId: the results of one check so far. With blog, cards count every post of that blog Uplika has checked so far (earlier report cards, keyword checks with this blog, and the 1, 7 and 30 day rechecks of posts published through Uplika), not only the last scan; lastScan.total is the size of the last scan. Of the five axes, search_title, consistency and topic_focus come from the post titles; ai_cited and search_exposed come from search checks.

blog.description: A Naver blog id or any link to the blog, for its report card.

post.description: A Naver post address (blog.naver.com/<id>/<logNo>) of any blog, or the id of a post published through Uplika, for that post's record.

runId.description: A runId from check_naver_visibility or scan_naver_blog_visibility.

workspaceId.description: Which workspace this is for. Only needed when the account has more than one — the error tells you the ids when it matters. Leave it out if it is already decided; do not ask the person again.

name: get_naver_visibility
